about: Mean Streets of Gadgetzan's interface (docs/packs/format.md, 'UI theme'): the goblin city at night as a noir crime town — dark rain-wet panels like smoked glass with brass rims, buttons of Kabal purple that glow jade under the mouse, warm lamplight text, the jade-gold accent of the Jade Lotus and the rusty red of the Grimy Goons for danger, rain falling over the menu in neon colours; the title in Classic's Cinzel Decorative, in jade gold.
